text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Claiming a brilliant victory in the Make Debut was—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing!
Bono-chan, that was a great race~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, whoa, what an incredible presence!
That's the first time I've ever seen a girl that big running!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Right?! It's so intense and super powerful...!
I'm so excited for what comes next~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
choice_data_list: Welcome back, that was a great race!
Welcome back, that was a great race!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
After crossing the finish line, everyone in the stands
was smiling so brightly. I was so happy~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I wanna see even more smiles on everyone's faces~
I want the stands to be packed and bursting with cozy warmth!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I want to be able to run bono races
that leave everyone smiling—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: We've gotta get those stands way, way more packed full of people~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right! Now that that's settled,
I'm gonna cook a whole bunch of food~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't quite get it, but
maybe Hishi Akebono has her own reasons."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Whatever the case, if we want to aim for even more thrilling races,
we'll need people to come watch... in other words, lots of fans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While keeping up with training,
I also want to actively work on winning over fans!
